The '''Piluvia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Torch Nebula/Legends|Torch Nebula]], a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the phenomenon known as the [[Piluvian salamander-storm]].<ref name="Jedi Healer">''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Piluvia system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which was authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]] and which placed the system in grid square P-19.<ref name="TEA" />
